name: Aichtal (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Aichtal (green and yellow bars under a yellow chief with a black antler).
history: Arms and flag were granted to the city of Aichtal by the Landratsamt Esslingen on 4 December 1978.

features.role: Aichtal arms — green and yellow bars with black antler
